pools.title: Fund Pools
pools.dust: The transparent amount is too small to be shielded.

meetironwood.title: Meet Ironwood
meetironwood.step1-body-1: **Ironwood** is a new, more private home for your Zcash. Its privacy is mathematically proven to work.
meetironwood.step1-body-2: After the **NU6.3** upgrade, the old **Orchard** pool stops taking in new funds, and new payments go to Ironwood. Move your Orchard balance to Ironwood.
meetironwood.phase1-body: **Phase 1: Split.** A quick internal transaction standardizes your balances to protect your privacy.
meetironwood.phase2-body: **Phase 2: Send in batches.** Each batch goes out in its own time window. Nothing is sent in the background, we'll notify you when it's time to send each batch. You'll open the app to authorize it.

ironwoodbanner.warning: **NU6.3** has activated. Your Orchard **{amount}** need to migrate to Ironwood.
ironwoodbanner.inflight-splitting: Splitting your notes. Tap Continue to finish.

migrationstrategy.title: Migration Strategy
migrationstrategy.intro: Since this is a cross-pool transfer, amounts will be revealed. Choose the privacy level of the migration.
migrationstrategy.now-body: One transfer, done in minutes. Your full balance of **{amount}** becomes publicly visible on-chain.
migrationstrategy.private-body: Spreads transfers over ~3 days in standard amounts, blending with other users. Requires opening the app a few times.
migrationstrategy.close-confirm-message: If you exit now, you won't be able to spend your Orchard funds until you migrate. You can resume the migration anytime from the home screen.

migrationsending.title: Sending transactions
migrationsending.subtitle: Sending your Orchard notes to the Ironwood pool. Keep the app open until every transaction is sent.
migrationsending.hint: This can take a moment. Please keep the app open.

migrationsplitplan.title: Split transactions
migrationsplitplan.subtitle: We'll create **{count} transactions to yourself** simultaneously. We are simply restructuring your funds for migration.
migrationsplitplan.subtitle-one: We'll create **1 transaction to yourself**. We are simply restructuring your funds for migration.
migrationsplitplan.rounds-note: They will go out in {rounds} rounds, each confirming before the next begins.
migrationsplitplan.stranded-note: Some tiny amounts stay behind: moving them would cost more in fees than they are worth.
migrationsplitplan.footnote: Scheduling the batches unlocks once all splitting transactions confirm.
migrationsplitplan.replanned: Your notes changed — review the updated plan.
migrationsplitplan.nothing-body: Your Orchard pool has no funds worth migrating right now.
migrationsplitplan.nosplit-body: Your Orchard notes are already the right size, so there is nothing to split. You can go straight to scheduling the migration.

migrationsplitting.title: Splitting your notes
migrationsplitting.subtitle: Creating and confirming the split transactions. Keep the app open — confirmations take about a block.
migrationsplitting.preparing-round: Round confirmed — preparing the next one…
migrationsplitting.hint: This can take a few minutes. Please keep the app open.
migrationsplitting.complete-subtitle: All splitting transactions confirmed — your notes are ready.
migrationsplitting.error-hint: Nothing is lost — you can retry now or come back later from the home screen.

migrationschedule.title: Review & confirm
migrationschedule.intro: Confirming sends the first batch now and schedules a **reminder for each later batch**. When a reminder arrives, open the app and send that batch.
migrationschedule.miss-note: If you miss a window, the batch simply waits for a future one — that's expected, not an error.
migrationschedule.reminder-body: Open Zingo to send this batch to Ironwood.
migrationschedule.denied: Notifications are off. Come back via the home screen banner when you're ready.

migrationstatus.title: Migration underway
migrationstatus.next-open-now: Batch {n}'s window is open. Send it when you're ready.
migrationstatus.all-sent: All batches sent. Waiting for the final confirmations.
migrationstatus.reminders: We'll send you {n} notifications to remind you.
migrationstatus.reminders-one: We'll send you a notification to remind you.
migrationstatus.footer: We'll let you know when the next batch is ready. Each batch is manually sent.
migrationstatus.stalled-body: Nothing was scheduled to send. Start over to plan it again from the notes your wallet holds now.

migrationbatchsending.title: Sending batch
migrationbatchsending.subtitle: Broadcasting this window's parts to Ironwood, spaced apart for privacy. Keep the app open.
migrationbatchsending.nothing: Nothing was due to send right now.
migrationbatchsending.slid-body: None of this batch's parts could be built right now, usually because syncing hasn't reached the batch's anchor height. Nothing was sent. The parts slid to a coming window and the schedule stays intact. Let the wallet finish syncing and try again.

migrationtransactions.title: Migration transactions
migrationtransactions.subtitle: We'll create **{count}** transactions to yourself simultaneously.
migrationtransactions.nothing-body: Your Orchard pool has no funds worth migrating right now.
